title: Mileage Adjustment to the Value of a Keyturn Vehicle Listing
content:
The highest odometer reading standing on the condition record of a Keyturn Vehicle Listing adjusts the marketplace figure by a share.

| Highest odometer reading standing on the condition record | Share the figure is adjusted to |
| --- | --- |
| 60000 miles or more | 0.94 of the figure, ninety-four hundredths |
| 35000 miles or more but below 60000 | 0.97 of the figure, ninety-seven hundredths |
| below 35000 miles | carried at the figure unchanged, a share of 1 |

As clauses: a vehicle whose highest odometer reading standing on the condition record is 60000 miles or more is adjusted to ninety-four hundredths of the figure; one whose highest standing reading is 35000 miles or more but below 60000 is adjusted to ninety-seven hundredths; and one whose highest standing reading is below 35000 miles is carried at the figure unchanged.

*At each boundary.* A vehicle showing exactly 60000 miles as its highest standing reading takes 0.94; at 59999 miles it takes 0.97. A vehicle showing exactly 35000 miles takes 0.97; at 34999 miles it is carried unchanged.

*Worked on a hypothetical figure.* A figure of 50000.00 USD adjusted at 0.94 gives 47000.00 USD; the same figure adjusted at 0.97 gives 48500.00 USD.
